items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: And we used to play in there, three pieces, me, Joey and that boy, Buckeye.

ctx.x: I remember someplace, I'll look it up in my notes.

But this boy, his boy was an Italian boy, his name was Sam you know. So well we used to play there on Wednesday, Friday, and we couldn't play Saturday because we was playing in wrestling you see, every Saturday. Then after that the war, then the war, second war, broke out. So that made us, we was playing on Chapitula, we was playing for this fella so that's why this fella, Speck, he wanted us to wait for him. He's building a new dance hall. Moulin Rouge. Moulin Rouge, you see. In fact, Speck already had a dance…
That's when the new sheriff came in there.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I had a boy called Alvin. He was playing drums. Alvin Clemons, what he called, Bokeye, Wilford Bokeye.

ctx.x: Who all was in the band? I can't hardly see anybody there.
Well, you see I had a boy called Alvin. He was playing drums. Alvin Clemons, he did, you know him. Alvin Clemons, what he called, Bokeye, Wilford Bokeye.
Is he a sax player or what? Yeah, saxophone player.
